Subject: POC success criteria & timeline — ClearFrame pilot

Thanks again for a productive demo today — quick recap and proposed next steps.

Summary of discussion:
- Objective: Validate Redwood inference for ClearFrame's document extraction pipeline (OCR post-processing + entity extraction) in a production-like load.
- Timebox: 4 week pilot (2-week integration + 2-week evaluation), target kickoff week of 2027-02-22.

Proposed success criteria (we discussed these on the call; please flag anything that should change):
1) Latency: p95 generation latency <= 200ms for average 1.5k token inference (document chunk).
2) Throughput: sustained 50 inference QPS at 95th percentile latency SLO; burst capacity to 120 QPS for spikes.
3) Cost: observed cost <= $0.30 per 1k tokens for inference during evaluation window (including caching benefits).
4) Quality: labeled-eval F1 >= 0.92 on the extraction testset; hallucination rate < 1% on a 500-sample audit.
5) Reliability: service availability >= 99.9% during the evaluation phase; automatic fallback to smaller model with graceful degradation on capacity shortage.

Evaluation plan (owners & artifacts):
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): ClearFrame shares sample dataset (anonymized) + success-weighted scoring rubric (owner: Elena).
- Week 1-2 (integration): Redwood provides sandbox deployment, API keys, and sample harness. Integration lead (Redwood): Ben Carter; Customer eng: Marcus Dunn.
- Week 3 (load & baseline): Run baseline throughput/latency tests and iterate on batching/quantization settings. Metric leads (Redwood): Karthik Iyer.
- Week 4 (evaluation): Execute labeled test evaluation and produce scorecard. Owner (ClearFrame): Elena; Redwood will produce a report and cost / token metrics.

Deliverables we will share at end of pilot:
- Evaluation scorecard (latency, throughput, cost/token, quality metrics)
- Recommendation deck with model/config suggestions, cost projection, and recommended rollout approach
- Runbook for production handoff and SLOs

Attachments included: clearframe-poc-plan.xlsx (detailed week-by-week tasks), sample_prompts.jsonl (anonymized prompts for scoring), redwood-poc-sla-draft.pdf (SLA draft for pilot).

Immediate next steps (please confirm):
- Customer: confirm sample dataset delivery by 2027-02-18.
- Redwood: send sandbox credentials and kickoff calendar invite for 2027-02-22.
- Procurement: if procurement needs a draft SOW or PO template, CC procurement@clearframe.ai and we'll share the standard SOW template.

If this looks good I'll lock the kickoff time and get Ben to start the sandbox provisioning.
